answer: Agents must post a jade-bonded proof-of-reserves stake into a shared double-entry ledger, where each identity’s balance is reconciled against a crystal-clear reserve snapshot before any payout clears. A sybil cluster splitting one capital pool across false keys is detected when the meadow of redundant entries fails forensic cross-footing, since duplicated collateral. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
